evidence.title: Churn prediction for a telecom
evidence.snippet:
# Churn prediction for a telecom

**Client:** a media company (synthetic).

## Problem
The client needed classical machine learning models and had no in-house capacity.

## What I did
I built the solution with scikit-learn, gradient boosting, pandas. The work also involved scripting and automation.

## Result
The project raised recall on churners from 0.58 to 0.81.
